tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should enclose Experience Certificate (work done/performance certificate) of having supplied Chassis Mounted 14 cum capacity Refuse compactor (Minimum 1.No) to Government of Karnataka /Government of India/ PSUs/ Government Local Bodies, Government Boards and Autonomous Institutions value not less than Rs 23.25 Lakhs Satisfactory supply certificate to be uploaded in any one year of the last five years

Bidder should have achieved a minimum of Rs. 46.50 Lakhs turnover in any One of the last Three Financial years. Balance sheet/profit & loss statement/Income tax returns statements for the same, certified by the Auditor.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Line of Credit of Rs. 14 Lakhs from any nationalized bank as per the format given in the document
other related documents as mentioned in tender document
Name, Permanent address and Contact No and company registration certificate
Affidavit on a Rs 100.00 stamp paper stating the firm is not Black listed by any government departments/agencies/Institutions
Should and must compulsorily have local service centre in Karnataka and the details of the same should be attached.
